## START HERE · No paid AI
1. Click **Execute workflow**.
2. Open **Review draft (stops here)** and read Output → JSON.
3. Edit **Sample enquiry** to try another fictional name or set photoCount to 0.

This workflow uses fixed rules and template text. It does not read image files, call an LLM, write to Studio, record approval or send messages. Publishing is not needed.

nodes.name: Sample enquiry
nodes.notes: Fictional inputs only. photoCount is a number, not uploaded images.

nodes.name: Simulated reading - NO AI
nodes.notes: Fixed template and simple validation. No model or network calls.

nodes.notes: Open Output / JSON to read the draft. This is not an approval action.
